executiveSummary.description: shopizer_mcont_1923 is a Java 11 Spring Boot Maven multi-module e-commerce application (Shopizer 3.2.5) that was containerized for AWS EKS. All 53 blockers across 10 rules were fixed: absolute file paths replaced with environment variables, hardcoded IPs externalized, HttpSession and singleton state externalized to Redis via Spring Session, local caches migrated to Redis, local file storage migrated to EFS-backed paths, and tightly-coupled components decoupled. The project already had spring-boot-starter-actuator with health endpoints configured. A multi-stage Dockerfile using maven:3.9.4-eclipse-temurin-17 for building and eclipse-temurin:11-jdk as the runtime base image was created. Container files include Dockerfile, .dockerignore, docker-compose.yml, Kubernetes manifests (namespace, deployment, service, ingress), build/push and deploy scripts, and DEPLOYMENT.md. The build compiles successfully on Java 11. Before deploying to AWS EKS, provision an EKS cluster with AWS Load Balancer Controller, EFS CSI Driver, and ElastiCache for Redis, then run scripts/build-push.sh and scripts/deploy-image.sh.
